description: Sri Lanka Railway - Amended the rules for the Conveyance of Parcels H. C. and D goods, livestock and fares from to time with effect from 1st of February 2024
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made by the Minister of Transport under the Railways Ordinance, amending regulations for parcel conveyance, cloakroom charges, and fare charts. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework changes, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, and the content is primarily regulatory rather than governmental structural/personnel matters.
